sources.title: DILG Barangay Officials Profiling System - Region 2 masterlist of elected barangay and SK officials (August 2026)
sources.publisher: Department of the Interior and Local Government - Barangay Information System (NBOO)
sources.effectivePeriod: Region 2 masterlist export retrieved 2026-08-28 (42,919 rows); the 633 rows for the Municipality of Maddela feed this record, covering all 32 barangays
sources.notes: Owner downloaded the export (official-list_02_2026-08-28.xlsx) from the DILG barangay officials directory masterlist page and supplied it for import. Column structure and the Maddela subset were verified programmatically: 633 rows across all 32 barangays (three exact duplicate rows removed on import, leaving 630 officials), exactly one punong barangay per barangay, TERM column 2023 - 2026 on every row. Names, positions and telephones agree with the system's web listing for all 316 overlapping rows, whose spellings also confirm the Ñ restorations for the Santo Niño barangay cells and the Fredireck and Recto Leaño names. Covers eight roles per barangay: punong barangay, 6-7 sangguniang barangay members, SK chairperson, 5-7 SK members, barangay treasurer, barangay secretary, SK secretary and SK treasurer. Carries TERM (2023 - 2026) and TERM IN PRESENT POSITION (1ST/2ND/3RD, blank for appointed roles and some members). No email column and no photographs. Absent-value markers N/A, NONE and 0 in BARANGAY TEL NO. are treated as absent. The export carries a lost-character marker (U+FFFD) in place of Ñ in 23 Maddela cells; 21 are confirmed by the web listing and 2 (Jay-Ar Leaño, San Pedro SK member; Noemi Maraña, Villa Hermosa Sur treasurer) are restored contextually and disclosed in the record's listing basis.
